name: resend
description: Resend: send email (idempotent retries; agent sends need an opt-in and an optional recipient allowlist), batch sends, sent emails, scheduling and domains

nodes.title: Send email
nodes.description: Send an email (html/text or a template), now or scheduled; returns the email id (as an agent tool only when RESEND_TOOL_ALLOW_SEND=1)

from.description: Sender on a verified domain, e.g. "Acme <news@example.com>"

text.description: Plain-text body (generated from html when omitted)

template_id.description: Published template id or alias (instead of html/text)

scheduled_at.description: Send later: ISO 8601 or natural language such as "in 1 hour"

tags.description: Tags [{name, value}] (ASCII letters, digits, _ and -), e.g. [{"name": "category", "value": "welcome"}]

topic_id.description: Topic id; contacts who opted out of the topic are skipped

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Send batch
nodes.description: Send up to 100 emails in one call (no attachments or scheduling); recipients are not checked

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get email
nodes.description: One sent email with its html/text, recipients, last_event and scheduled_at (agent tools get html/text omitted)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.description: Emails your team sent, newest first

outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Resend API request
nodes.description: Call any Resend API endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/audiences". Only the API's own host is allowed. Agent tools may only read paths under /domains, /audiences, /contacts, /broadcasts, /templates, /topics, /segments.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/audiences"
